claim: Keyboard entry accepts 225x5, 100x8kg, and 135 × 10, starts a rest timer, and files a workout receipt.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; log all three public formats, finish the workout, and reload its receipt

claim: Mixed-unit workouts report separate lb-reps and kg-reps totals.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; log the verifier's exact 2000x999, 100x8kg, and 135 × 10 set sequence; assert separate totals and reject the raw mixed sum

claim: Sets logged from two open tabs are merged instead of replacing either set.
sandbox: two pages opened before either write; log Squat 225x5 in one and Bench press 185x5 in the other; reload and assert both records

claim: Exercise aliases can be added and used when logging.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; add rdl for Romanian deadlift and log through that alias

claim: Logging, fixed rest timers, aliases, receipts, and export work without a Pro license.
sandbox: fresh unlicensed browser storage; set a fixed timer, add an alias, export CSV, log, and finish a receipt

claim: The log exports JSON and CSV and restores a compatible JSON backup.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; inspect exports, reject malformed JSON, then import a valid backup

claim: A completed receipt can be copied as readable text.
sandbox: fresh browser storage with clipboard permission; finish one workout and read copied receipt text

claim: A completed receipt has a clean print or PDF view.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; finish a workout, invoke print, emulate print media, and assert receipt-only output

claim: Erase all local data removes workouts and custom aliases and restores default settings.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; create data and non-default settings, erase, reload, and assert defaults

where: logger demo action, banner, README, and demo guide
sandbox: fresh browser storage at /?demo=1; make a real set, edit demo data, exit, re-enter, and assert the seed sample and real set

claim: Ordinary demo logging sends requests only to this site.
sandbox: fresh demo flow with every request recorded; log and change settings; assert every request is same-origin

claim: The app loads no analytics, ads, external fonts, or third-party scripts.
sandbox: fresh browser visits every public route with all requests recorded; assert every request is same-origin

claim: Set Receipt is a record-keeping tool and does not give training or injury advice.
sandbox: fresh browser; assert the product boundary is visible and public routes contain no prescriptive training, diagnosis, or injury-treatment language

claim: The logger works offline after the first visit.
where: logger facts, manifest description, and README
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context at /?demo=1; wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, log, and reload again

claim: The rest timer stops at DONE and announces completion.
sandbox: verified Pro fixture with a 15-second rest interval; log a set; wait through completion; assert stable DONE, restart control, and live completion notice

claim: Pro costs $9 once through Sociobot checkout when checkout is available.
where: landing, Setup, terms page, and README
sandbox: fresh browser storage with recorded unavailable and available catalogue responses; assert $9, disabled outage state, 900-cent listing, and exact checkout URL

claim: A valid Pro license enables custom rest intervals and private receipt notes and is checked at most daily.
sandbox: mocked valid Sociobot response; capture a license, set custom rest, persist a note, reload, and assert one verification request

claim: A new token enables Pro only after successful verification; an already verified valid token can work offline.
sandbox: controlled PWA shell; open with a never-verified token offline and assert Pro stays locked; verify online; reload offline and assert only the verified token remains active

claim: Purchase terms identify Sociobot/Dodo as merchant of record and state that handled refunds automatically revoke Pro.
sandbox: fresh browser; assert disclosures on public terms and Setup; return a recorded revoked verdict and assert paid controls remain locked
